items.title: CVE-2026-125836 — HIGH
items.summary: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Nicu Micle Simple JWT Login simple-jwt-login allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects Simple JWT Login: from n/a through 3.6.8.

items.title: CVE-2026-118855 — HIGH
items.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability through invoice import. An authenticated user with invoice-creation permission can import HTML in an invoice status field. When another authenticated user opens that invoice's edit form, Akaunting renders the stored status in a hidden input with raw Blade output, allowing attacker-controlled markup to execute in the victim's Akaunting origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-8333 — CRITICAL

items.title: CVE-2026-8331 — HIGH
items.summary: An unrestricted upload of files with dangerous type vulnerability in the Microchip TimePictra platform allows functionality not properly constrained by access control lists, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-87772 — HIGH

This issue affects Pardus About: before 1.2.5.

An authenticated user with the Create Query Reports permission could exploit specially crafted database queries to execute arbitrary commands on t

items.title: CVE-2026-76792 — HIGH
items.summary: The User Verification by PickPlugins WordPress plugin before 2.0.49 does not rate limit the verification step of its one-time-password login, and does not expire the generated code, allowing unauthenticated attackers to brute force it and log in as any user, including administrators, where the code is configured to use digits only.

items.title: CVE-2026-124815 — CRITICAL
items.summary: The Clockinator Lite WordPress plugin before 1.1.0 does not restrict access to several of its record deletion actions, and uses a user-supplied table name in a SQL query without validating or escaping it, allowing unauthenticated users to perform SQL injection attacks, deleting data from any database table and extracting sensitive information such as password hashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-124814 — CRITICAL
items.summary: The Ultimate Addons for Elementor Forms WordPress plugin before 1.0.8 does not properly validate the extension of uploaded files in its bundled file upload field, allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files such as PHP scripts and achieve remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-124647 — HIGH
items.summary: The TI WooCommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin before 2.0.7 does not sanitise and escape user input before using it in a SQL statement in a front-end endpoint, allowing unauthenticated users to perform SQL injection attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-123092 — HIGH
items.summary: The WP Remote Users Sync WordPress plugin before 2.3.0 does not restrict which user metadata keys may be written through its incoming user synchronisation requests, allowing a site that holds the shared synchronisation keys to set the capabilities of any existing account and escalate it to administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-123044 — HIGH
items.summary: The ContentPen WordPress plugin before 1.1.1 discloses its REST API key to unauthenticated users, who can then use it to create posts containing unfiltered JavaScript, leading to Stored XSS that executes in the browser of any visitor, including administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-122003 — HIGH
items.summary: The Abilities Bridge WordPress plugin before 1.4.2 does not require a valid nonce before re-authenticating a REST API request from the logged-in session cookie, allowing attackers to make a logged-in administrator perform any REST API action, including creating a new administrator account and taking over the site, by tricking them into opening a crafted page (CSRF).

items.title: CVE-2026-119040 — HIGH
items.summary: The Defender Security  WordPress plugin before 6.4.1 does not limit the number of failed two-factor authentication attempts in its default configuration, allowing an attacker who already knows a victim's password to brute-force the one-time code and defeat the second authentication factor.

items.title: CVE-2026-118597 — HIGH
items.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in custom invoice payment terms. An authenticated Manager can save a crafted custom payment-term value. When an authorized user opens Invoice Settings for the same company, Akaunting inserts the stored value into a client-side event-handler expression, causing attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the victim's authenticated origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-110959 — CRITICAL
items.summary: The Descope WordPress plugin before 1.2.0 does not validate the authentication token it receives before creating a WordPress session, accepting any non-empty token, so an unauthenticated attacker can obtain a session for any existing account, including an administrator, by supplying that account's email address.

items.title: CVE-2026-101107 — HIGH
items.summary: An OS command Injection issue exists in Air Terminal 6 provided by SoftBank Corp. Arbitrary commands may be executed with the root privilege by a user who can log in to the web management console of the affected product.

items.title: CVE-2026-85101 — HIGH
items.summary: An authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the rsync in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.2.1-69057-13, 7.2.2-72806-10, 7.3.2-86009-5, and 7.4.1-90080-1 allows remote attackers to read specific files, write arbitrary files, and conduct limited denial-of-service attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-119977: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
items.summary: WordPress WordPress Core. WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades. Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
